BiblicalUsage: Halak is a mountain of Edom, named twice as the boundary of the conquest — from the mount Halak, that goes up to Seir, to Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon, the land Joshua took. It is the southern edge of the land Joshua measured out.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a mountain can be a border: Halak is where the promised land stops going south, and God measures His gift by mountains.
